source: Alexandra Palace Visitor Regulations & Security Information

bag_policy.comparison: Approximately the size of a standard A4 sheet of paper or small clutch/handbag
permitted_types: Small cross-body handbags within the 30cm x 20cm x 10cm dimension limit
Small clear plastic bags within size limits
Medically necessary bags (subject to search and prior medical declaration)
Essential baby care bags for accompanying infants
prohibited_types: Backpacks and rucksacks of any size (including mini fashion backpacks)
Holdalls, weekend bags, and duffel bags
bag_policy.arena_entry_rule: Oversized bags, backpacks, and suitcases are strictly prohibited inside the Great Hall and cannot be brought past the security checkpoints.

venue_bag_drop.advisory: Under Alexandra Palace's general Great Hall policy, an external bag drop for oversized bags operates by the East Court car park at a published charge of £10 per item. However, event-specific operational confirmation for the 2026/27 World Darts Championship has not yet been explicitly published. Spectators traveling with luggage should confirm its availability before travelling or deposit bags at central London station left-luggage facilities (e.g. King's Cross or Euston).

bag_policy.cloakroom_status: Inside the venue, cloakrooms (when operational) accept light coats only and do not accept luggage, backpacks, or oversized items.

methods: Sniffer dogs deployed for drug and pyrotechnic detection
security_screening.re_entry_policy: Strictly no re-entry. Once a spectator's barcode is scanned and they exit the venue, re-admission is prohibited.
security_screening.age_restriction: Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult aged 21 or over at all times.
security_screening.accessibility_exceptions: Dedicated accessible search lanes operate at Palm Court for wheelchair users, spectators with mobility equipment, and those carrying verified medical supplies.

prohibited_items.items: Outside alcohol, glass bottles, metal cans, unsealed drinks, and thermos flasks
prohibited_items.exception: Empty reusable plastic water bottles (to fill at free water points) and small factory-sealed water bottles up to 500ml.

prohibited_items.items: Football shirts, club scarves, or football-affiliated emblems of any club worldwide
prohibited_items.reason: Strictly enforced by security to maintain a neutral, friendly darts party atmosphere and prevent rivalry tensions.

prohibited_items.items: Hard plastic, metal or wooden weapons, sharp implements, realistic toy guns, swords, and scythes
prohibited_items.rule: Only soft foam or cardboard accessories are permitted. Inflatables over 1 meter or obstructing spectator view are banned.

prohibited_items.items: Full-face covering masks, motorcycle helmets, or balaclavas
prohibited_items.rule: Spectators must remove full-face coverings at the security turnstiles for facial ID and age verification.

prohibited_items.items: Professional cameras with detachable telephoto lenses, external microphones, tripods, selfie sticks, and drones
prohibited_items.rule: Standard smartphones and non-professional compact cameras are permitted for personal spectator memories.

prohibited_items.items: Vuvuzelas, whistles, air horns, musical instruments, laser pens, and megaphone devices
prohibited_items.rule: Strictly confiscated at entry gates to prevent player distraction on the oche.

prohibited_items.items: Flares, fireworks, smoke canisters, illegal substances, and hazardous liquids
prohibited_items.rule: Immediate confiscation, refusal of entry, and referral to Metropolitan Police.
